pages.text: Atlas is a map of the area. This is where you have to create it, which is one of the features of FreshCraft.$(br)Once you enter it, you will see a map, tabs, and a pointer.
There is no longer a key to open it.$(br)It is created using $(7)compass$() and $(6)book$().
pages.title: Атлас
Atlas
pages.text: You can change the map scale and put labels.

The arrow on the bottom right is needed so as not to lose yourself on the map.$(br2)You can familiarize yourself with the functions of the tabs by reading their names.$(br)You can put labels and names on the atlas map, as well as erase them.

pages.title: The Mark of Death
pages.text: After one's death, death marks appear on the atlas.
They can also be erased. The atlas shows an approximate landscape of an area with biomes, but it does not show caves, some buildings and dungeons.
